- **`Clone` and `PartialEq`:** it asserts an error equals its clone. It asserts inequality when only the line differs and when only the message differs, so equality compares both fields.
- **`Eq`:** the nested helper `assert_eq_impl::<OutlineError>()` is bounded `T: Eq`, so it fails to compile without `Eq`.
- **`Error`, `Display` and `Debug`:** it coerces the value to `&dyn std::error::Error` and asserts the `to_string()` output. The coercion requires `Error`, `Display` and `Debug`, so `Debug` is checked at compile time. `Debug` has no separate output obligation.

`crates/trust-but-verify/tests/public_api.rs#fn[public_exports_match_the_appendix]` also checks the public export inventory and that the Habeas consumer compiles. This supports the exported shape but is not needed for the behavioral obligations.

I found no untested obligation, no ambiguity and no marking gap.
